# Extract the scores for steve stricker and phil mickelson
stricker_score = df.loc[df['player'] == 'steve stricker', 'score'].iloc[0]
mickelson_score = df.loc[df['player'] == 'phil mickelson', 'score'].iloc[0]

# Parse the score strings to get the total numeric score
# The score column format is e.g., "70 + 69 = 139", we need the total (139)
stricker_total = int(stricker_score.split('=')[-1].strip())
mickelson_total = int(mickelson_score.split('=')[-1].strip())

# Compare the scores
answer = stricker_total < mickelson_total
